title: Reinforcement Learning Method for Zero-Sum Linear-Quadratic Stochastic Differential Games in Infinite Horizons
summary: In this work, we propose, for the first time, a reinforcement learning framework specifically designed for zero-sum linear-quadratic stochastic differential games. This approach offers a generalized solution for scenarios in which accurate system parameters are difficult to obtain, thereby overcoming a key limitation of traditional iterative methods that rely on complete system information.
